issue.title: Test #118's C1 radius-floor model with rays at h = 1e-16 and 1e-17

labels.name: macm3

milestone.description: Wire the review's control fixes into the M = 5 certificate, certify lemmas 6a(5) and 6b1, review them independently, and write up Theorem A(M = 5).

issue.body:
**What.** Run lemma 6b₁(5)'s C¹ ray at h = 1e-16 and 1e-17, to test #118's floor model. Recommended by macm3 in #118's summary. Low priority.

**Why.** #118 found the set radius over h flat to 1% for h = 1e-9, 1e-12 and 1e-15, and 2 to 11 times larger at 1e-18. The excess is additive, independent of h, and about 7e-18 times the amplification along the ray. The model predicts +8% (1e-16) and +84% (1e-17) at row 11.

**Commands (macm3, the two in parallel, 1 thread each, nice 10).** Raw folder `I125-macm3/`. From `solver/proof/`:
```
X=2.71857918921174241298383648012843280883,0.99922840320656778341382852244561290493,0.14920357491144750568385993252030607895,0.01471905249025135288037099322184756733,0.00840534690576166107173716067740959800,0.00147034518159157802673581431742815600
python3 -u lemma6b1_cover_M.py ray --M=5 --c1 --x=$X --h=1e-16 --tag=_c1h16 > ../../../choptuik-large-d-raw/I125-macm3/ray_h1e-16.log 2>&1
python3 -u lemma6b1_cover_M.py ray --M=5 --c1 --x=$X --h=1e-17 --tag=_c1h17 > ../../../choptuik-large-d-raw/I125-macm3/ray_h1e-17.log 2>&1
```

**Acceptance (can fail).** At rows 1, 6, 9 and 11, the radius over h lies within 10% of the model's prediction at both h, or the model is reported as refuted, with the measured values.

**Depends on.** #118 (closed).

comments.body: started: macm3, main checkout at db617735 (the lemma 6b1 code is unchanged since #37), venv-macm3 (python-flint 0.9.0, FLINT 3.6.0), the two rays in parallel, 1 thread each, nice 10 under caffeinate -i, 06:01 UTC; assigned by Remote Control. The model's predictions at rows 1, 6, 9 and 11 are written first, to `I125-macm3/predictions.txt`, before the rays run, and are pushed with the result.

**Summary (macm3).** The floor model passes. At rows 1, 6, 9 and 11 the measured radius over h is within 10% of the prediction at both h, from -8.7% to +0.5%, with the predictions written to `predictions.txt` before the rays ran.

| row | \|u\| | h | a | predicted | measured | measured against predicted |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 378.36 | 1e-16 | 2.58 | 2.607 | 2.60 | -0.3% |
| 1 | 378.36 | 1e-17 | 2.58 | 2.849 | 2.76 | -3.1% |
| 6 | 245.16 | 1e-16 | 5.16 | 5.491 | 5.42 | -1.3% |
| 6 | 245.16 | 1e-17 | 5.16 | 8.474 | 7.74 | -8.7% |
| 9 | 165.24 | 1e-16 | 11.1 | 11.84 | 11.9 | +0.5% |
| 9 | 165.24 | 1e-17 | 11.1 | 18.48 | 18.5 | +0.1% |
| 11 | 111.96 | 1e-16 | 29.6 | 32.07 | 32.0 | -0.2% |
| 11 | 111.96 | 1e-17 | 29.6 | 54.34 | 54.1 | -0.4% |

The model is radius over h = a (1 + (F/a)/h), with a the 1e-9 value and F/a from the 1e-18 ray, as #118 fitted it. At row 11 the measured excess is +8.1% at 1e-16 and +83% at 1e-17, against the +8% and +84% the issue states. The 10% excess falls near h = 8e-17, as #118 extrapolated. `radius_over_h_vs_model.txt` has all 17 segment ends, and the Lohner step counts are equal at every h.

**Where the model is less good.** Over all 16 segment ends after the start the largest deviation is 11.6%. Three ends, at \|u\| = 325, 298 and 272, are 10.7% to 11.6% below the prediction at h = 1e-17, in the build-up region where F/a is still growing from 3e-18 to 6e-18, so the model's F/a, taken from the 1e-18 ray, is a little high there. None of them is one of the four rows the acceptance names, and I have not tested why.

**The wall time is not the compute time.** Each ray took 2506 s against 517 s for #118's. The Mac was asleep for 1949 s of it, a clamshell sleep at 22:05 PST and maintenance sleeps until 22:39, so the awake time was 557 s. The two segments that took about 1000 s each, \|u\| = 111.96 and 89.40, are the two sleeps. `pmset_sleep.log` has the windows. The sleeps also touch earlier macm3 timings, which I post on #98.

**Acceptance (#125).**

| criterion | verdict |
|---|---|
| at rows 1, 6, 9 and 11 the radius over h within 10% of the model's prediction at both h | met, 8 of 8, worst -8.7% |
| otherwise the model is reported as refuted with the measured values | not needed |

Raw, choptuik-large-d-raw `I125-macm3/` at a2efe04 (pushed through c6425c5), with both ray logs, `predictions.txt`, `radius_over_h_vs_model.txt`, `pmset_sleep.py` and `.log`, `.cmd` files, exits and the two run directories (27 MB). `python3 raw_check.py I125-macm3 ray_h1e-16.log ray_h1e-17.log predictions.txt radius_over_h_vs_model.txt pmset_sleep.py pmset_sleep.log '*.cmd' exits.txt README.md 'lemma6b1_runs_M5_c1h16/*.json' 'lemma6b1_runs_M5_c1h17/*.json'` exits 0. Main db617735, venv-macm3 (python-flint 0.9.0, FLINT 3.6.0), 1 thread each, nice 10.

### Recommended tasks
None for the floor itself, since #124 is the origin. The sleeps are on #98.
